review_evidence: README describes FinMap as a sparse finite-map library with algebraic operations, support, and an ExtTreeMap/TreeMapD implementation layer.

Direct inspection found the FinMap and TreeMapD structures plus theorem-rich Basic, Algebra, Support, and ExtTreeMap modules proving lookup, update, support, fold, algebraic-law, and extensionality results.
The test/example modules contain executable examples and proposition-level checks that remain useful formal-source evidence under the corpus policy; no stronger lossless exclusion was identified.
summary: Retain the finite-map library and its formal algebraic API, theorem support, and examples without hard exclusions.
